title: Axisymmetric ring-electrode resistor: layered washer (electric currents, analytic)
description:
Electric currents with geometry 'axisymmetric' (x = r, the axis is x_lo, y = z): a washer of outer radius b made of a resistive film sigma_film (thickness t_film, on top) on a substrate sigma_sub (t_sub). The inner ring electrode (terminal at V0 on the rectangle a_hole < r < a_ring, the whole height) and the outer rim electrode (voltage 0 V on x_hi, r = b) drive a radial current; the z faces are insulated. The hole r < a_hole is enclosed by the ring, so it floats at V0 and carries no current. The layers are in parallel: the field is radial and the same in both.
Analytic: V = V0 ln(b/r)/ln(b/a_ring) for r > a_ring, J_r = sigma V0/(r ln(b/a_ring)) in each layer, whole-ring conductance G = 2 pi (sigma_film t_film + sigma_sub t_sub)/ln(b/a_ring) (in S: held currents are whole rings on (r, z)), R = 1/G, P = G V0^2, film current 2 pi sigma_film t_film V0/ln(b/a_ring).
Derived values tab: G_ring and R_ring (ring electrode current / voltage), I_rim (scalar output current_rim = -G V0), P_joule (ring-weighted integral of q_joule = V0 I exactly), I_film (ring-weighted integral of J_x over the film / (b - a_ring) = the film current), V_probe (film probe at a cell centre next to sqrt(a_ring b)). Expect G, I, P ~3.5e-5 below the analytic value (the series ring conductances are a trapezoid rule of ln(b/a_ring)), I_film ~4e-5, V_probe ~1e-5.
Sweep tab: G_ring versus sigma_film (1 to 1000 S/m on a 1 S/m substrate: from substrate- to film-dominated) with the dashed G_vs_sigma_film.
Line profile tab (sigma_film = 1000 S/m): V_radial (field V along the film, V0 in the hole and the ring), J_film and J_substrate (field J_x = J_r in each layer, 0 in the hole and the held ring).

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: inner ring electrode voltage [V]; the outer rim is held at 0 V

parameters.name: sigma_film
parameters.description: DC conductivity of the top film in S/m (swept)

parameters.name: sigma_sub
parameters.description: DC conductivity of the substrate in S/m

parameters.name: a_hole
parameters.description: inner radius of the ring electrode (the washer hole)

parameters.name: a_ring
parameters.description: outer radius of the ring electrode (inner edge of the resistor)

parameters.name: b_outer
parameters.description: outer rim radius = domain size along r

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (layer and electrode edges on cell edges)

parameters.name: y_film
parameters.description: height of a film cell-centre row

parameters.name: y_sub
parameters.description: height of a substrate cell-centre row

parameters.name: r_probe
parameters.description: probe radius: the cell centre just outside sqrt(a_ring b) = 2 mm, where V is about V0/2
